question: Identify the full names and majors of members who both attended the event with the highest attendance and have at least one approved expense exceeding $100.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036, maj.XCL_031
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS maj ON m.XCL_042 = maj.XCL_030
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
WHERE a.XCL_001 = (
    SELECT a2.XCL_001
    FROM attendance AS a2
    GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
    ORDER BY COUNT(a2.XCL_002) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
      AND ex.XCL_021 = 'true'
      AND ex.XCL_020 > 100
)

SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036, maj.XCL_031
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS maj ON m.XCL_042 = maj.XCL_030
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
WHERE a.XCL_001 = (
    SELECT a2.XCL_001
    FROM attendance AS a2
    GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
    ORDER BY COUNT(a2.XCL_002) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
      AND ex.XCL_021 = 'true'
      AND ex.XCL_020 > 100
)
